blocks.subtitle: For businesses and consumers
blocks.text:
Last updated: 24 November 2026

These terms apply to every quote, order and contract between Webdevamin and its clients. Some rules only apply to businesses, others only to consumers (private persons who do not buy for their business). Where that is the case, we say so.

1. Who we are

Webdevamin is a sole proprietorship (eenmanszaak) registered in Belgium with company and VAT number BE0798993057, located at Eigen-Haardstraat 39, 8400 Ostend, Belgium. Email: amin@webdevamin.com.

2. Scope

  • These terms apply to all our services: designing and building websites and booking systems, hosting, domain names, maintenance, support, SEO and related work.
  • Your own general terms do not apply, unless we accepted them in writing.
  • If a clause is invalid, the rest stays valid and the invalid clause is replaced by a valid one that comes as close as possible.
  • If this text and a signed quote differ, the quote prevails.

3. Quotes and how a contract starts

  • Our quotes are valid for 30 days, unless the quote says otherwise.
  • The contract starts when you accept the quote in writing or by email, or when you complete our payment page and sign the SEPA direct debit mandate.
  • Obvious mistakes in a quote or on the website do not bind us.

4. Our services

  • Subscription: we build your website and keep it running for a fixed amount per month. Unless the quote says otherwise, the subscription includes hosting, a domain name, maintenance, security updates, basic SEO and support for small changes.
  • One-time payment: you pay a fixed price for building the website, without subscription. Hosting and domain name are then your own responsibility, or we arrange them separately for a yearly fee.
  • Extras: extra features or larger changes are offered separately, as a one-time surcharge or an upgrade to another package.
  • We do our work with care and according to the rules of our profession. This is an obligation of means, not of result: we cannot promise specific results such as rankings in Google or a number of customers.
  • We aim for a website that is always available, but cannot guarantee 100% uptime. Short interruptions for maintenance or caused by our hosting providers are possible.

5. Your responsibilities

  • You give us the texts, images, logos and other material we need on time. Delays on your side can move the planned delivery date.
  • You confirm that you may use the material you give us and that it does not infringe the rights of others. If someone files a claim about your material, you protect us against it.
  • You are responsible for the content of your website and for the legal texts that apply to your own business, such as your privacy policy and terms. We can help you with this, but the final responsibility is yours.
  • You keep your login details for our client platform secret.

6. Prices

  • Businesses: prices are in euro and exclude VAT, unless stated otherwise.
  • Consumers: the price we ask you to pay always includes VAT where VAT applies. Your quote shows the total price you pay. Whether Belgian VAT (21%) applies depends on where you live: for private persons outside the European Union it often does not, and your quote and invoice then show the price without VAT.
  • We may change subscription prices after the minimum term. We announce this at least 30 days in advance by email. If you do not agree, you can end the subscription before the new price applies, without costs.

7. Payment

  • Subscriptions are paid in advance by SEPA direct debit, per month, quarter or year as agreed. You sign the mandate on a secure page of our payment provider Stripe.
  • We send you an invoice and a notice by email before each collection.
  • One-time projects are paid by bank transfer within 14 days of the invoice date, unless agreed otherwise. We may ask for a deposit before we start.
  • Late payment by businesses: interest is due automatically, without notice, at the rate of the Belgian law of 2 August 2002 on late payment in commercial transactions, plus a fixed compensation of €40 for collection costs.
  • Late payment by consumers: we first send a free reminder and give you 14 days to pay. If you still do not pay, we may charge interest at the legal interest rate plus 8 percentage points and a fixed compensation within the limits of Book XIX of the Belgian Code of Economic Law (at most €20 for amounts up to €150, €30 plus 10% of the amount between €150.01 and €500, or €65 plus 5% of the amount above €500, with a maximum of €2,000).
  • If a payment fails, we try to collect it again. If an invoice stays unpaid after a reminder and the payment term above, we may suspend the website and our services until you pay. We tell you before we do this.

8. Duration and ending the contract

  • Unless the quote says otherwise, a subscription runs for at least 12 months from the launch of your website. After that, you can end it every month.
  • You end the subscription by email. It stops at the end of the billing period in which you send your notice. Amounts already paid for that period are not refunded, except under article 9 or when the law requires it.
  • When the subscription ends, we transfer your domain name to you free of charge, so you keep your web address. If you also want to keep the website, we move it to your own account for a one-time price agreed in advance. If you do not want this, the website goes offline.
  • Either party can end the contract immediately by email if the other seriously breaches it and does not fix this within 14 days after a written notice, or in case of bankruptcy.

9. Money-back guarantee

If you are not satisfied within 30 days after the launch of your website, tell us by email. We then refund the subscription fees you paid so far and the contract ends. The website goes offline and the domain name is transferred to you or cancelled, as you prefer. This guarantee does not apply to one-time projects or extras that were already delivered.

10. Right of withdrawal (consumers only)

As a consumer, you can withdraw from a contract concluded online or at a distance within 14 days after the day the contract was concluded, without giving a reason. To do this, send us a clear statement by email, or use the model form at the bottom of this page.

  • We refund all payments within 14 days after receiving your withdrawal, using the same payment method.
  • If you asked us to start work during the 14-day period, you pay an amount in proportion to the work already done until you told us you withdraw.
  • If you expressly asked us to complete the service within the 14 days and confirmed that you then lose your right of withdrawal, you no longer have this right once the service is fully performed.

11. Intellectual property

  • Subscription: the design, code and technical setup of your website remain our property during the subscription. You may use the website for your business as long as the subscription runs. If you buy the website when you leave (article 8), the rights to that website pass to you once the agreed price is paid.
  • One-time payment: the rights to the website pass to you once the full price is paid.
  • Your own content (texts, photos, logos) always stays yours.
  • Our own tools, platform (webdevamin.app), reusable components and third-party software (such as open-source code, fonts or images with their own license) are never transferred. You receive a right to use them as far as needed for your website.
  • We may mention your website in our portfolio, unless you ask us not to.

12. Liability

  • Businesses: our total liability per year is limited to the amounts you paid us in the 12 months before the event that caused the damage. We are not liable for indirect damage, such as lost profit, lost data or lost customers, except in case of fraud or intentional fault.
  • Consumers: we never limit our liability for death or personal injury, for intentional or serious fault, or for not performing the main obligations of the contract.
  • We are not liable for damage caused by your own material, by changes you or others made to the website, or by failures of third parties we cannot control, such as hosting providers, payment providers or internet providers.
  • Keep copies of important content yourself. We make regular backups, but cannot guarantee that every version can always be restored.

13. Force majeure

We are not liable for delays or failures caused by events beyond our reasonable control, such as illness, natural disasters, large outages of providers or cyberattacks. If force majeure lasts longer than 60 days, either party may end the contract without compensation.

14. Privacy

We process your personal data as described in our privacy policy. When we process personal data of your visitors or customers for you, our processing agreement applies. It forms part of these terms.

15. Changes to these terms

We may change these terms. We announce changes to clients at least 30 days in advance by email. If you do not agree, you can end the contract before the change applies, without costs. Otherwise the new terms apply from that date.

16. Complaints, applicable law and courts

  • Complaints about our services can be sent to amin@webdevamin.com. We answer within 14 days and look for a solution together.
  • Consumers can also contact the Belgian Consumer Mediation Service (Consumentenombudsdienst), consumentenombudsdienst.be.
  • Belgian law applies.
  • Businesses: disputes go to the courts of the judicial district of West Flanders.
  • Consumers: you can always go to the court that is competent under the law, including the court of your place of residence.
  • These terms exist in Dutch and English. If they differ, the Dutch version prevails.
